notes:
- Mean velocity now includes the slow start of each push (phase look-back 5 -> 12 samples).
- Use companion app 1.0.9 or later: older apps set the old value back on every connection.
- Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md
- Known limitation: live velocity and position can be off at the start of some sets.
